title: Slovene Government Bilateral Scholarships
provider: CMEPIUS - Centre of the Republic of Slovenia for Mobility and European Educational and Training Programmes
description: Short-term study and research mobility scholarships (3 to 10 months) at Slovenian higher education institutions for citizens of countries with a bilateral education agreement with Slovenia.
amount: EUR 400 per month plus free accommodation in a student dormitory and subsidised meals

title: Ad Futura Scholarships
provider: Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia
description: The Ad Futura programme provides scholarships and grants for international study, research mobility and participation in study visits and competitions, including support for foreign nationals studying in Slovenia under specific calls.
amount: Tuition and/or living cost support (varies by call)

title: University of Ljubljana Institutional Scholarships
description: Tuition reductions and merit awards for international students admitted to a degree programme at Slovenia's largest university.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction (varies by faculty and programme)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Slovenia-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Slovenian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
